biography.plain_text: Timothy Williams, known as Tim, co-founded Media Storm with Craig Woerz in 2001. The American advertising executive built a business specialising in audience planning and media buying for entertainment companies. After attracting private-equity backing and expanding its services, the agency was acquired from its founders and TZP Group by Dentsu Aegis Network.

long_biography.plain_text:
Advertising entrepreneur Tim Williams responded to clients seeking more than audiences for individual programmes by broadening the creative work his agency offered. He and Craig Woerz established MAUDE as a subsidiary specialising in brand development and campaigns across different media. They put marketing and creative director Marc Klatzko in charge of the new operation.

Williams also promoted interactive television as an extension of conventional advertising. Media Storm's renewed DirecTV agreement combined thirty-second commercials with features such as recording reminders, requests for information and programme samples. Clients included Food Network, HGTV, WE tv and Magnolia Pictures.
